title: $1 Million to Play a Different Game
description:
A game company paid him 1 million dollars. To play its game.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Ninja (gamer): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ninja_(gamer)

From Wikipedia (Ninja (gamer)): his Twitch followers grew from 500,000 in September 2017 to over 2 million by March 2018; that month he set the record for the largest concurrent audience on an individual stream outside tournaments, 635,000; in December 2018 he estimated he made close to US$10 million that year; Reuters reported Electronic Arts paid him US$1 million to promote Apex Legends, a rival battle royale to Fortnite, on his stream and social media in February 2019. Not financial advice.

#shorts #ninja #streamer #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you start a new game, remember:
cta: Fortnite or Apex? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: A game company paid him 1 million dollars. To play its game.
But not his usual game. A rival to Fortnite.
Just months earlier, he had 500,000 followers. Then over 2 million.
Then he played Fortnite with Drake. A record crowd tuned in.
That year? Close to 10 million dollars, by his own guess. Just from playing.
